setup_steps: Give each player: random character card, Training track + tracking cube (color), set of 8 metals, 4 character-specific starting cards + 6 Funding cards shuffled as starting deck, health dial set to 36
If fewer than 4 players, remove extra components including unused starting/funding cards
Shuffle Market deck, reveal top 6 cards as 'the Market'
Place Boxing and Atium tokens near Market
Shuffle and reveal 3 random Mission cards; place a tracking cube per player on each
Choose first player. 2nd player (clockwise) gets +2 health, 3rd gets +4 health, 4th gets +4 health and 1 Boxing
If more than 2 players, last player (clockwise from first) gets the Target
Each player draws 5 cards as starting hand

deckbuilding_rules.card_visibility: Players may look at own hand and discard anytime, never at own deck
deckbuilding_rules.play_order: Any order chosen by the active player
deckbuilding_rules.acquired_cards_go_to: discard pile immediately, unless stated otherwise
deckbuilding_rules.end_of_turn_cleanup: All in-play cards except Allies move to discard; unplayed hand cards also discard
deckbuilding_rules.deck_reshuffle: When a draw is needed and deck is empty, shuffle discard pile into new deck
deckbuilding_rules.eliminated_cards: Removed from game into a shared Eliminated pile, visible to all players

combat_rules.damage_usable_only: at end of turn, split freely between Allies and players
combat_rules.ally_death: requires damage >= Defense value in one hit; no partial damage; moves to owner discard on death
combat_rules.defender_ally_rule: Damage cannot target the player or non-Defender Allies while a Defender Ally is alive; defender must be killed first (must have enough combat to kill it or cannot use damage against it)
combat_rules.two_player_mode: At end of turn, may direct all combat at opponent and their Allies (optional)

three_four_player_mode.target_mechanic: Last player (clockwise from first) starts holding the Target
three_four_player_mode.target_damage_rule: After attacking any Allies, remaining damage from your turn MUST go to whoever holds the Target
three_four_player_mode.target_passing: Only after a Target-holder takes damage from another player; they may then pass Target to anyone; passing happens only after all damage for the turn is used
three_four_player_mode.player_elimination: If Target-holder is eliminated, attacker may move Target to any remaining player, remaining damage carries over; if only 2 players would remain, Target is removed from game

healing.symbol_effect: raise health dial, cannot exceed max 40

turn_structure: 1. Move one space right on Training track

2. Any order, any number of times: play cards from hand; burn/flare metals; use cards as metal; discard to refresh flared metal; activate Ally/character abilities; advance Mission tracks; buy cards/Boxings from Market
4. Attack players (reduce health) - Target may move after this step if Target holder took damage
5. Discard all in-play cards (except Allies) and remaining hand
win_conditions: Reach the top of all three active Mission tracks first (instant win)
Be the last player remaining (all others eliminated)
Play 4 total Atium on the card 'Confrontation' (primary ability + secondary ability requiring 3 more Atium)

mission_track_rules.multiple_mission_points_same_turn: may be split across multiple tracks or spent all on one
mission_track_rules.cube_ties_rule: A single cube on the track image area is not 'on the track'; with only 1 cube actually on track it counts as highest but not lowest. With 3+ cubes on track, ties at top/bottom count as highest/lowest respectively
mission_track_rules.first_to_finish_track: permanently counts as highest on that track thereafter
mission_track_rules.rewards: each Mission has mid-track rewards (one-time), first-player-only bonus rewards at each reward point, and a top reward (one-time or permanent) plus an extra one-time top reward for whoever reaches it first

solo_coop_mode.turn_flow: Each player takes a normal turn (never attacking other players/their Allies), then draws and resolves the top card of the Lord Ruler deck (Adversary or Edict)

adversary_cards.shield_destroy_rule: damage >= shield value destroys it; shields destroyed left to right only; X shield value = current Dominance value; multiple shields can be destroyed same turn if enough damage; any player can attack any Adversary regardless of who it's assigned to
adversary_cards.effect_types: permanent negative effect OR end-of-turn negative effect (resolves before drawing new hand) for the player the Adversary is assigned to

edict_cards.structure: up to 4 sequential effects: Dominance increase (1-2 steps, sometimes player-count conditional), additional effect (usually negative), Lord Ruler healing (10 HP per uncompleted Mission, max 48), market clearing (Lord Ruler eliminates 2 specific market cards, instantly replaced)
edict_cards.mission_completion_definition: only ONE player needs to have reached a Mission's top reward for it to count as completed

end_conditions: Lord Ruler deck runs out -> players lose
All players eliminated by damage -> players lose
Lord Ruler reaches 0 health -> players win
A player plays 4 Atium on Confrontation -> players win

special_rulings.sense_in_coop: SENSE abilities have NO effect on the Lord Ruler
special_rulings.solo_track_position: in solo, a player is 'lowest' on a track only if started but hasn't reached first reward; 'highest' only after passing the highest reward before the final one; gets first-player reward for every reward tier
special_rulings.collective_damage: shared among all players; may be distributed however players choose; if 1 player, they take it all
